import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int x = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[x];
        for (int i = 0; i < x; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        Arrays.sort(a);
        if (x == 1) {
            System.out.println(a[0]);
        } else {
            if (x % 2 == 0) {
                // Note: For even x, x%2 == 0, so a[-1] which is out of bounds.
                // This will throw ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in Java.
                System.out.println(a[x % 2 - 1]);
            } else if (x == 5) {
                System.out.println(a[(x % 2) + 1]);
            } else {
                System.out.println(a[x % 2]);
            }
        }
    }
}
